continuity.palette_arc: Use the D001/D002 mineral palette throughout: dominant burnt sienna and earth ochre, deep maroon, warm cream, muted olive, dark brown contours, and the established deep indigo-blue only for Guruvayurappan. Begin with subdued maroon-brown pain and let restrained ochre-gold warmth grow toward the final prayer.
continuity.narrative_arc: Blessed devotion, the poet’s illness and plea, confidence in grace, examples of saintly bliss, deepening devotion, embodied worship, ecstatic vision, honest lament, and lifelong surrender.
continuity.notes: Commentary and narrative are derived only from the cleaned Facebook photo captions. Keep Bhattathiri and Guruvayurappan visually continuous. Full-bleed matte murals only; no detailed or glossy variant.
